whatThisFileIs: An R1 authorship claim, and nothing else. It says who wrote the compliance-path file below and on which issue. It asserts nothing about whether it is correct, and it carries no `reviews[]` entry.
scopeOfTheClaim: R1 only: authorship of the listed paths on AFC-805. It is not clearance of the retention gate (plan 0.10.5), which only the CEO can clear. No migration, engine, gate, or bootstrap file is touched by this change.
whatTheChangeActuallyDoes: AFC-805 (parent AFC-756, follow-up to AFC-801): suite tests/db/86_events_registrations.sql section 86.7 reverses and re-applies migration 0044 (event_expenses, whose event FK is ON DELETE RESTRICT) around the 0021 events drop. (1) Down phase: inserted the 0044 down-script include after the 0023 down include and before the 0021 down include, so the expense register drops before events. (2) Re-apply phase: inserted the 0044 forward include after the 0021 forward include so later suites see the register. (3) Hardening: pre-rollback emptiness assertion now also requires event_expenses count = 0. One deviation beyond the issue letter, stated for review: the 0021-forward + 0044-forward re-applies are wrapped in SET ROLE directus_migrator / RESET ROLE (the 21_register_seal_after_rollback.sql precedent). Without it the 0044 forward fails its 0042-pattern ownership precondition (refusing the event_expenses register: public.events is not owned by directus_migrator), because the 0021 re-apply run as the harness session role leaves events owned by that role. Production runs every forward as the migrator, so this is the faithful identity, not a widened one. No other file touched.
